Sourcing Viable Materials in Crypto Markets

Spot vs. Perpetual
Futures (Basis)

| The exact same asset across two
markets. The spread (funding rate) is
stationary by definition, making it the
most mathematically reliable pair.

Sector Pairs (Highest Stability)

* L1 Blockchains: SOL/AVAX, NEAR/APT
(High liquidity, 3-10 day half-life).

* DeFi Protocols: AAVE/COMP, UNI/SUSHI
(Medium liquidity, 5-15 day half-life).

¢ L2 Solutions: ARB/OP, MATIC/MANTA
(High spread volatility).

* Memecoins: Unpredictable structural
risk. Not recommended.

monitoring; cannot be traded blindly.

2. Daily volume >$10M per asset.
3. Reasonable half-life between 1 and 30 days.

The Overfitting Trap Walk-Forward Stepping Stones
_ Standard ‘train on all / test on all’ backtesting generates
wildly optimistic, functionally useless results for statistical
arbitrage.

The Walk-Forward Protocol forces the system to estimate
parameters on the past and trade only on unseen future data.

Structural Vulnerabilities and Real-World Failure Modes

Funding Rate Reversals /A\

The Threat: Basis trading exposes the
system to negative funding. In Dec 2022,
longs paid shorts -0.02% per 8h (a $60
daily bleed per $100K position).

The Mitigation: Real-time systemic
monitoring and cross-exchange funding
rate arbitrage routing.

The Threat: The Achilles heel of stat arb.

During macro crashes, correlations spike to
1 (all assets drop), but cointegration breaks
(spreads blow out to 100 and never return).
Picking up pennies in front of a steamroller.

The Mitigation: Hard 40 stop-losses, strict
leverage limits (2-3x max), VIX-based
capital scaling, and portfolio diversification
(10-20 pairs).
